summary: Frontend-only smoke test of /previsions page after improved 404 error message. Both scenarios validated: (1) NOMINAL load works end-to-end on Emergent preview, (2) Simulated 404 on /api/weather/severe displays the new full remediation message and does NOT crash the page.

details.error_text: Endpoint /api/weather/severe absent du backend (HTTP 404). Le serveur tourne sur une branche obsolète. Sur le VPS : sudo BRANCH=Version_With_Detector bash /opt/storm-monitor/upgrade.sh

critical_code_review_comments: PrevisionsPage.jsx loadSevere correctly distinguishes axios status 404 vs other HTTP vs network error - clean implementation
Error banner has data-testid='previsions-error' which makes future regression testing easy (good)

Note: FranceMapPanel component fetches /api/weather/severe/grid independently and shows its own 'Erreur de chargement' badge on the map tile when that endpoint fails. The improved error message in PrevisionsPage only covers /api/weather/severe (the parent chart data), NOT the grid endpoint used by FranceMapPanel. If the VPS is on the wrong branch, all three endpoints (severe, severe/grid, severe/profile) are 404 - the user will still see a generic 'Erreur de chargement' inside the France map and inside VerticalProfileChart. Consider propagating the same detailed remediation message to FranceMapPanel + VerticalProfileChart for consistency.
Minor: useEffect at line 113 calls loadSevere() every 5 min - on a persistent 404 this re-triggers the error toast and re-renders. Acceptable but could be backed off after first 404.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PrevisionsPage error handling validated end-to-end with page.route() mocking on /api/weather/severe**. The same approach can be reused for FranceMapPanel (/api/weather/severe/grid) and VerticalProfileChart (/api/weather/severe/profile) if main agent extends the improved error message to those components.
rca of the issue: Not applicable - this iteration only validated a UI error-message improvement. Root cause of the original VPS bug (wrong github branch 'Testing' deployed on Kimsufi instead of 'Version_With_Detector') is environmental and confirmed by user; the frontend now displays an actionable remediation message instead of a generic 'Erreur lors du chargement des prévisions avancées'.
